drg.description: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease without CC/MCC

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 69-year-old female admitted for COPD exacerbation. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.61, creatinine 0.91, hemoglobin 11.8, pao2 53, platelets 257, sodium 139, wbc 8; vitals dbp 76-81, heart_rate 70-73, map 94-98, o2_flow 0-40, resp_rate 27-32, sbp 129-134, spo2 88-94, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; High-flow nasal cannula 40 L/min, FiO2 0.6; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.92, hemoglobin 11.8, platelets 258, sodium 139, wbc 8; vitals dbp 76-79, heart_rate 70-74, map 94-97, o2_flow 40, resp_rate 21-25, sbp 127-134, spo2 93-95, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Albuterol-ipratropium nebulizer; Prednisone 40 mg PO
Assessment and plan: COPD exacerbation. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 69-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: COPD exacerbation. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
